messages:
Alyssa Chen: Quick heads-up  BluePeak renewal next week. They asked for a concise SLA summary, uptime history, p95 trend, and how credits would be calculated. Need a 1-pager and the suggested concession by EOD tomorrow. @Raj can you pull a 30d export? @Emma please confirm root cause for the p95 bump on 02/11.

Raj Patel: On it. Initial 30d headline: uptime 99.978%, p50 ~65ms, p95 ~235ms. Notable spike on 2026-02-11 03:22 UTC. Export URL and CSV snippet below.

Emma Rivera: That spike corresponds to a canary model rollout. Root cause = KV cache warmup causing higher token latencies on certain paths. No outage, rollback + cache priming resolved it.

Mike O'Neill: Contract SLOs: monthly uptime 99.95%, p95 <=220ms. Credit rule: >2% of minutes above latency threshold to trigger formal credit. BluePeak had ~1.8% minutes over threshold, so not eligible by contract. Will double-check with legal.

Olivia Park: Renewal note: they want an RCA + clear mitigations before signing. We should include an internal action list and a short customer-friendly summary in the deck.

Alyssa Chen: Action list: (1) Raj  add full CSV + small chart link, (2) Emma  2-sentence RCA for customer slide, (3) Mike  confirm legal on credits + recommend concession, (4) Olivia  draft the customer one-pager (mark concessions optional). Meeting Fri 10:00 AM PT to review.

Raj Patel: CSV snippet and chart: https://redwood.internal/metrics/bluepeak/2001234567
```
date,p50_ms,p95_ms,uptime_pct
2026-02-01,60,180,100
2026-02-11,62,240,99.997
2026-02-12,61,200,99.999
2026-02-28,64,220,99.990
```
Full export in shared drive.

Emma Rivera: RCA blurb for deck:
"On 2026-02-11 we observed elevated p95 latency during a canary model rollout. Root cause: cache-warmup leading to KV-cache misses for a subset of request paths. Immediate fix: rollback and cache priming; long-term: staged warmup traffic in rollouts and an automated tail-latency alarm. Patch shipped 2026-02-13."

Mike O'Neill: Legal confirmed credit threshold is >2% of minutes. BluePeak ~1.8% so no mandatory credit. Recommendation: offer a 5% goodwill invoice credit for one month as a renewal concession (optional). Use only if customer presses.

Olivia Park: +1 on optional 5% credit. Frame it as a one-time goodwill gesture tied to renewal sign.

Alyssa Chen: Great. I'll draft the one-pager and internal action queue and post here by EOD. Meeting invite sent for Fri 10:00 PT.

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: BluePeak SLA & renewal review  Friday 10:00 AM PT (invite sent).
